items.title: Remove hardcoded runtime reviewer CLI path
items.context: scripts/verify-runtime-reviewer-contract.mjs must derive the CLI under test from the current repo instead of a stale .worktrees/B-8f6a path, so the contract runs from any checkout and fails only on real runtime/reviewer regressions.

happy.desc: Running npm run test:runtime-reviewer-contract uses the current repository dist CLI, not any .worktrees/B-* path, and passes after build.

edge.desc: If packages/main/dist/cli.js is missing, the contract fails with an actionable build message instead of silently using a stale path.

adversarial.desc: The contract source must not contain a hardcoded Orchestrate .worktrees/B-* CLI path.

items.userSees: 用户运行 `npm run test:runtime-reviewer-contract`，终端显示 "runtime reviewer contract verified"；脚本源码里不再出现 `.worktrees/B-*` CLI 路径。

verificationEvidence.note: runtime reviewer contract now resolves a runnable repo dist CLI dynamically and no longer hardcodes stale .worktrees/B-8f6a; command passed.

items.title: Block prompt/template reviewRound number drift
items.context: scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs must scan agent templates and mirrors for reviewRound:number schema snippets and fail unless the text explicitly refers to story_review.planReviewRound. Template/mirror docs should say signed reviewRound is ISO string.

happy.desc: Running npm run test:process-fact-contract fails on prompt/template schema snippets that say reviewRound:number for signed finding/review pass fields.

edge.desc: The contract still allows story_review.planReviewRound:number and the legacy numeric PLAN alias wording when explicitly distinguished from signed reviewRound.

adversarial.desc: Agent prompt mirrors and templates contain no bare reviewRound:number or F-035 numeric reviewRound drift after the fix.

items.userSees: 用户运行 `npm run test:process-fact-contract`，终端显示 "Process fact contract verified"；如果 prompt/template 写回 `reviewRound: number`，终端显示具体文件行并失败。

verificationEvidence.note: Process fact contract now scans prompt templates and mirrors for bare reviewRound:number, F-035 numeric reviewRound, and numeric reviewRound JSON examples; command passed.
Synthetic story_review.planReviewRound:number case remains allowed while signed reviewRound:number snippets fail; command passed.

verificationEvidence.command: rg reviewRound numeric prompt drift scan
verificationEvidence.note: No prompt/template/mirror numeric reviewRound drift remains after updating templates and mirrors.

items.title: Make silent catch audit a baseline gate
items.context: scripts/audit-silent-catches.mjs should compare uncategorized catches against a committed baseline. Existing debt may remain in the baseline, but any new uncategorized catch must fail instead of just reporting.

happy.desc: Running npm run audit:silent-catches passes with the committed baseline for existing uncategorized catch debt.

edge.desc: The audit output identifies the baseline file and current uncategorized count so maintainers know old debt is intentionally tracked.

adversarial.desc: Injecting a new uncategorized catch outside the baseline causes audit:silent-catches to fail and report the new file/line/snippet.

items.userSees: 用户运行 `npm run audit:silent-catches`，终端显示 "silent catch audit passed"，并显示 baseline 文件和当前 uncategorized 数量。

verificationEvidence.note: audit:silent-catches now loads committed baseline, reports 501 existing uncategorized catch debt, and passed with newUncategorized=0.
baseline update path regenerated scripts/audit-silent-catches-baseline.json and self-validated baseline schema/duplicates with newUncategorized=0.

items.title: Encode fresh-worker evidence boundary
items.context: Koala cannot mechanically prove a spawned agent has no prior context, but it can hardcode the observable boundary: dispatch/process-event evidence must record worker assignment and current gates must not treat prompt-only claims as worker proof. Add or verify a contract that documents and tests the mechanical evidence boundary.

happy.desc: A hardcoded contract or smoke verifies worker evidence is based on dispatch/process-event/commit evidence, not prompt-only text claims.

edge.desc: Documentation or contract text states Koala cannot prove true subagent context isolation, only observable assignment evidence.

adversarial.desc: A prompt-only claim that a fresh worker was used is not accepted as sufficient mechanical evidence in the relevant contract wording.

items.userSees: 用户运行 `npm run test:process-fact-contract`，终端显示 "Process fact contract verified"，且 contract 文案明确 "prompt-only worker claims are not mechanical evidence"。

verificationEvidence.note: Process fact contract asserts fresh-worker guidance names dispatch/process-event/commit evidence and rejects prompt-only worker claims as mechanical evidence.
CLAUDE.md, testing-infra.md, templates, and mirrors state Koala cannot mechanically prove true subagent context isolation, only observable assignment evidence.
Contract checks prompt-only worker claims are not mechanical evidence in every prompt containing fresh worker guidance.

items.title: Encode user-value delivery evidence boundary
items.context: Product acceptance cannot be fully reduced to code, but DONE/delivery checks can require concrete transcript/evidence artifacts instead of accepting text-only claims. Add or verify hardcoded contract coverage for transcript/delivery evidence expectations and document the non-mechanical boundary.

happy.desc: Delivery/product acceptance boundary is backed by transcript or delivery evidence language, not a plain completion claim.

edge.desc: The contract distinguishes non-mechanical user approval from mechanical evidence artifacts, avoiding a fake fully automated guarantee.

adversarial.desc: DONE guidance must not imply prompt-only user-value claims can satisfy delivery evidence without transcript/evidence reviewer support.

items.userSees: 用户运行 `npm run test:process-fact-contract`，终端显示 "Process fact contract verified"，且 contract 文案明确 "transcript/delivery evidence is required; prompt-only user-value claims are not enough"。

verificationEvidence.command: rg transcript/delivery evidence boundary docs and prompts
verificationEvidence.note: CLAUDE.md, testing-infra.md, product-reviewer prompt, and delivery-aware agent prompts state transcript/delivery evidence is required and prompt-only user-value claims are not enough.
Process fact contract asserts non-mechanical user approval wording so docs distinguish subjective user approval from mechanical evidence artifacts.
Contract checks delivery/product guidance rejects prompt-only user-value claims and requires transcript, verificationEvidence, delivery-check/product-reviewer evidence, or waiver.
